notes.title: Happy Holidays With WASD!
notes.content:
That Time Of Year:
It's the most wonderful time of the year once again. Celebrate it this time with cowboys, big numbers and thinly veiled references!

For the month of December you'll be able to take on limited time holiday enemies in Idle mode. Defeat them to steal their presents, ensuring you have a very happy holidays indeed. Collect enough to unlock limited time costumes and mounts in the event tab on the main menu, all the while enjoying a peaceful wintery theme.

Specifics:

10% chance to spawn holiday themed enemies that each drop 3 presents
2000 presents total required to receive all 5 rewards
Rewards include 3 character skins, each with an alternate color, as well as 2 mounts
Event runs the duration of December and will repeat every year

Permanent Changes

A few minor bug fixes and gameplay optimizations.
Fixed a very rare memory leak from occurring with the shotgun's golden bullets. Your memory is no longer leaky.
Modified Icicle Launcher to remove the %HP scaling, eliminating a combination that allows for infinite progression unhindered by boss health.
Icicle Launcher: 10% chance to do 3% (scaling) Max HP ice damage >> 10% chance to do Sheer Cold's damage x20 (scaling) ice damage

notes.title: WASD Full Release And MacOS Support!
notes.content:
The full release is finally here! After 3 months of additions and improvements, we think the game is in the perfect spot for a wider audience. Thanks a bunch to all of the Early Access players for the feedback and suggestions along the way! With that being said, let's get into the patch.


Additions:

 second WASD music album (40+ total minutes of OST now!)
 in-game guide (located in the options menu in Idle Mode)
 pet naming and info (can rename pets and see their weight and nature) 
 golden enemy particle effect
 AZERTY keyboard compatibility (toggle in options)
 Mac OS support (for versions before 10.15)
 setting to turn off clouds (toggle in options)
 progress visualizations (background objects added every 50 waves up to wave 500)
 rare time-warp enemy (that if defeated skips 10 waves)


Fixes and QoL:

 clicking outside of the escape menu closes it
 settings button opens up the escape menu
 escape menu moved to a more convenient location 
 opening a menu will close other left open menus
 added UI elements explaining how to unlock unlockable features
 various wardrobe page changes improving clarity
 various achievement page changes improving clarity
 various login page changes improving clarity
 made all options and settings pages open the same way
 made all X's feel responsive
 changed all scroll bars to match the UI more
 pets kick back slightly when firing
 outfit and weapon layering adjusted
 quotes will not fade when their corresponding enemy fades


Balance: 
Only balance changes this time around are some small reworks to the way HP scaling works. In general these changes should punish players more for only using 1 weapon (or 1 elemental interaction if you're using a pet), and also make getting through the late-late game (wave 5000+) a lot easier. If you're having trouble mowing through bosses after this patch, I'd suggest bringing a backup weapon.

The changes will also make the early game slightly faster, which could come in extra handy if you want to try out one of the official speedrun categories, where you try to beat wave 250 as fast as possible (https://www.speedrun.com/fastest_hands_in_the_wasd).

General:

 Health Scaling Formula After Wave 5000:
 Reduced from: (Wave/250)^8 + Wave^4 >> (Wave - 2500)^3.5
The health scaling was designed around the way crit previously worked, but since changing the formulas the late game health needed a nerf as well.


Bosses:

 Old: wave 1-249 = x2.5 HP, wave 250+ = x5 HP
 New: every 250 waves increases HP scaling by a flat x2.0 (capped at x10), starting at x2.0



Examples:

 Wave 100 Boss   : Old: x2.5 HP | New: x2 HP
 Wave 500 Boss   : Old: x5.0 HP | New: x4 HP
 Wave 1000 Boss : Old: x5.0 HP | New: x10 HP
 Wave 5000 Boss : Old: x5.0 HP | New: x10 HP



Closing: 

Thanks for coming with us on this journey! We'll still be doing updates here and there (especially for events and bugfixing), while also working on our next game (currently unannounced). If you liked this game and want to see other stuff we're working on, come stop by our discord server: http://discord.com/invite/eGVr5wU

notes.title: WASD Pets Update!
notes.content:
WASD Patch 15: Pets, Fixes and Balance

Gone are the days of robbing innocent bystanders for their cash on your own. With the new pet system you can spend your plat to roll from a capsule machine to get your very own companion. These pets will fight alongside you, dealing damage based off your stats while applying elements and passives of their own. With 30 pets to collect and randomized stats to min/max there's plenty to burn your hard earned platinum on. Unlock it by beating wave 500, and unlock additional pet slots at wave 750 and 1000.


 Added 30 pets, 6 of each element (neutral, water, ice, fire, poison)


Fixes:


 Fixed issue where lighting wasn't properly applying to character clothing at night.
 Fixed bug that caused "Unlock gun X times" achievement to be unachievable.
 Implemented checks to ensure night mode will always occur after 250, even if reaching it during offline progress.


Misc:


 Updated homescreen logo

notes.content:

Fixed an issue with certain mount visuals in the wardrobe preview.


Balance:
These changes are mostly to slightly speed up the early-game for new players. Right now on a new save file it takes a bit too long to get to the more interesting part of the game, so every weapon is getting some more damage.

 Vitals Multiplier (base): 200% >> 250%


Road Map:
Sometime later this month our Pet Shop update will be coming out, which will be the last major addition before the full release (which will probably happen a couple weeks after). The Pet Shop should be a good way for people to dump loads of platinum, which we know is an issue right now - especially for players who were playing when platinum was significantly easier to get (more details to come). At some point this month there should also be an update letting players who are doing tons of damage get further faster - which we know is also an issue right now.

Also later this month the second Official WASD Soundtrack is coming out, and all of the tracks will be put into the game (15+ more minutes of music). Just like the last soundtrack, you'll also be able to download it through Steam and add it to your library (thanks for 4k downloads on the first one!).

All of next month we're going to have a Halloween event. There will be a bunch of new spooky enemies (some of which will stick around after the event ends), as well as some exclusive outfits you'll be able to earn by taking them down. We're not sure if we're going to do this for all major holidays, but there's already enemies made for a Christmas event as well, so at the very least there will be another one.

notes.title: Wardrobe System, Daily Login Rewards, and In-Game Achievements
notes.content:
Patch 12! This is a big patch, so buckle in and get ready to read! Or ignore this and just go in blind, your call.

Wardrobe System:
We added a new system to help customize your WASD'ing experience. On the main menu you'll now find a  wardrobe button where you can change clothes and even equip mounts. Clothing can be obtained as a reward for daily logins, as well as some pieces can be earned via achievements in game.

Daily Login:
As a nice little reward for logging in you'll receive various rewards depending on the day. This isn't meant to be an incentive to get on, nor should it feel like an obligation to get every day. It's just a small bonus to say thanks for playing! Rewards are given in groups of 7, with the final day being a new cosmetic mount. Logins do not have to be done on subsequent days, so feel free to take your time checking in.

In-Game Achievements:
On the main menu you'll find another button for accessing the achievements page. Here you can collect various rewards (mostly platinum) for completing different achievements in the various modes. Even if you're not interested in the platinum, each achievement collected will give you a permanent damage bonus in Idle Mode, so it might be worth doing a bit of achievement hunting.

New Enemies:
Like in previous weeks, we've added in a new batch of enemies to loot, along with custom quotes and WASDex entries. Have fun adding to your collection!

General
Crit has been reworked. Crit was massively outperforming anything else, and with the current way it was designed it made it extremely difficult to balance. Crit should now perform slightly better early game but scale far slower, making it not as broken with large amounts of crit chance and damage. Players in late stages will likely notice a dramatic damage decrease if relying heavily on crit, but this change is meant to encourage other builds and more specific strategies, and was required to allow for healthy game balance in the future.

Balance Changes:
These changes are intended to make the early game slightly faster for new players, as well as make the late game slightly slower for player's who've heavily invested into NVG. At it's current cost NVG is far more valuable than buying hats for players going base damage builds (after wave 250), so this makes it more of a decision rather than a formality. On top of that there's a nerf to Fast Pass to limit the max amount, however we're adding the Fast Pass+, Fast Pass++, and Fast Pass Premium - allowing you to start at up to round 100 (for 2/3/4 Plat per stack respectively).

Pistol

 Gunpowder (base): 1 >> 5

Sniper

 Gunpowder (base): 6 >> 12

Shotgun

 Gunpowder (base): 5 >> 8

Knife

 Blade Size (base): 4 >> 8

NVG

 5% >> 3%

Fast Pass

 Max of 50 >> Max of 25


Quality Of Life and Fixes:

 Increased General Scroll Speed By 25%
 Modified Plasma Knife Description
 Applied A Maximum Text Size To WASDex Descriptions
 Fixed Triggered Explosives Not Working
 Reorganized Main Menu
 Moved Practice Button To Showdown Mode Level Select


As always, if there's any feedback, issues or general discussion to be had please feel free to post in the steam discussions, or on the games Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/eGVr5wU

Happy WASD'ing!
